label: Reflectance control
info:
Phone control for on-demand AS7341 leaf-reflectance measurements.

CHANGE the device id 'staging-01' in the two function nodes and three mqtt-in topics to target the balcony node.

- Dashboard at /ui : pick a plant, press Measure.
- HTTP for shortcuts : POST /reflect/measure?plant=<id> (or JSON body {"plant":"..."}) -> 202 {request_id}.
A fresh request_id is generated server-side each time (the firmware dedups by it). reflect/cmd is published NON-retained.

build cmd (http)

label: Measurement station
info:
Phase 3 server-side: resolve NFC tag UID -> plant_id, ack the ESP (stops its retries), republish an enriched plant_weight for Telegraf.

The ESP is at-least-once (same event_id resent up to 5 copies): ack every copy, write once per (dev,event_id) via 60s dedup.

UID map read by the 'file in' node from /data/tag-map.json (git-tracked broker/node-red/tag-map.json, bind-mounted; edit with add-tag.sh, re-read per measurement — no rebuild, no functionExternalModules dependency).

Telegraf subscribes ONLY to plant_weight (never measure/event_raw).

name: validate + ack + dedup
uid->plant_id + build plant_weight
